messages:
Riley: PSA  my apartment lost fiber for ~10 minutes and my smart thermostat got very dramatic. anyone else have smart-home devices throw tantrums when the internet dies? :pensive: 
Tara: oh absolutely. my lights went into disco mode when the router rebooted. considered it an unplanned standup. :stuck_out_tongue: 
Ben: quick poll: which three things do you unplug when you know a storm is coming? 1) modem/router 2) smart plugs 3) fridge 4) lava lamp. react 1/2/3/4.
Olga: 1 and 2 for me. fridge seems a bit extreme unless tornado.
Riley: results so far 1=3, 2=1, 3=0, 4=0. fridge stays plugged. lava lamp unplug = mood broken.
Tara: mini tip: set your home devices to static IPs or reserve DHCP leases so when your network comes back devices don't fight over addresses. saved me on a weird Hue re-pairing.
Ben: shoutout to @HomeBot for the outage alert earlier: saved me from joining a blank meeting. :raised_hands:
HomeBot: Automated: detected loss of internet at Riley's network 22:14 UTC, restored 22:25 UTC. Logging event.
thread_summary: WFH outage + smart-home chaos, poll about unplugging devices, tips for DHCP/leases, HomeBot alert
